BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to Glanleam, a spacious 4-bedroom detached bungalow set on an impressive and beautifully mature site of approximately 1,800 sq.m. (just under half an acre), perfectly positioned in the ever-popular Castlequarter area of Coosan, Athlone. With a floor area of approximately 118 sq.m., this property offers superb potential for families, upsizers, or anyone seeking a home with room to grow. Step inside to a welcoming entrance hall that leads through to a bright and airy L-shaped lounge and dining room?an ideal space for both everyday living and entertaining. A separate kitchen and breakfast room overlook the garden and provide direct access outdoors. Four generously sized bedrooms and a well-appointed family bathroom complete the main accommodation. One of Glanleam?s standout features is its excellent array of ancillary spaces. The integrated garage, measuring an impressive 22 x 13, offers huge potential for conversion?perfect for creating a home office, playroom, or additional living space, subject to planning permission.
Beyond this, the property boasts a further outbuilding, which was previously used as a workshop. This superb additional structure is a genuine asset, ideal for hobbyists, those needing dedicated workspace, storage, or even a future studio or garden room (subject to planning). Properties offering this level of flexibility and space rarely come to market in such a prime location.
The generous, private, and mature gardens further enhance the potential to extend the home, should a purchaser wish (subject to planning permission). Whether you're dreaming of adding extra living areas, creating a modern family hub, or simply enjoying the space as it is, the site offers wonderful possibilities.
Location is simply outstanding. Glanleam is just a five-minute walk from the highly regarded Coosan National School, making it a dream setting for families. Coosan Point and the shores of Lough Ree are moments away?perfect for lakeside walks, water activities, and enjoying the outdoors. Athlone town centre is a short drive, giving access to excellent shopping, dining, and transport links, while nearby motorway access makes commuting easy.
Glanleam represents a rare opportunity to secure a detached home on a large, mature site in one of Athlone?s most sought-after residential areas. With its fantastic workshop, generous plot, and exceptional location, this property offers space, convenience, and a wealth of future potential. A superb forever home or investment in a blue-chip address?this is one that truly ticks all the boxes.
For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact REA Hynes today on 0906474848 or info@hynes.ie

Disclaimer: Details provided by REA Hynes are for marketing purposes only and do not form part of any contract. While every effort is made to ensure accuracy, purchasers must satisfy themselves on all particulars. The property is offered subject to contract and availability. 

Outside
Step into the outstanding gardens of this Coosan home, set on just under half an acre. Mature trees and lush planting create a private, peaceful retreat perfect for family living or entertaining. Spacious lawns wrap around the house, framed by established hedging for superb privacy and year-round colour. Whether you want space for children to play, a relaxing spot to unwind, or a garden to grow, this outdoor haven delivers. A rare opportunity to enjoy countryside calm with town convenience right on your doorstep.

Ideally positioned in the highly sought-after Castlequarter area of Coosan, this property offers the perfect balance of peaceful residential living with superb convenience. Just moments from Coosan National School and within walking distance of Coosan Point and the shores of Lough Ree, the location is a haven for families and nature lovers alike.
Athlone town centre is only a short drive away, providing an excellent selection of shops, restaurants, schools, and leisure facilities. Commuters will appreciate the easy access to the M6 motorway, with direct links to Galway and Dublin, while local bus and train services make travel effortless.
Castlequarter combines mature, established surroundings with outstanding amenities, making it one of Athlones most desirable and convenient addresses.
